integrity.computation: Standalone exhaustive rational-payoff verification over 15136 placements and targeted welfare families; finite checks are corroborative only.
integrity.proof_basis: Explicit incompatible-deviation inequalities, disjoint combinatorial enumeration, exact welfare classes and Stirling asymptotics.
integrity.publication_priority: Bounded literature comparison, not an independently certified novelty determination.

scientific_limitations: Exactly one vacancy and two positive color populations on a complete bipartite graph with both parts of size at least two.
Agents maximize the fraction of unlike occupied neighbors; extra vacancies, stubborn agents and other utilities are not covered.
The near-balanced rarity formula assumes uniformly sampled colored placements with the fixed population composition.
The price-of-anarchy identity is for the specified K_{a,2} family, not for all bicliques.
title: Equilibrium rigidity and two efficiency regimes in one-vacancy biclique diversity games
